title: The Witcher 3 - Remastered
summary: Experimental PsychoV-30 replacement for the native DX12 HDR pipeline.
notes: Preserves exposed HDR through native grading, applies PsychoV-30 before UI composition, and outputs HDR10 with independent UI white.
Requires native HDR output. Scene rendering, grading controls and highlight roll-off have been checked live. Alternate views and output paths remain experimental.
Night lighting, camera lights, moon size and night grading are provided by the separate optional Darker Nights - Remastered addon.
